channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jalen Green | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jalen Green from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jordan Ott on Devin Booker, Jalen Green
item.description:
UPDATE: Jordan Ott on Devin Booker (right ankle sprain) and Jalen Green (right hamstring injury management and left hip contusion):

“Book is making tremendous progress. Obviously been on the court multiple times. Trending in a good spot and Jalen, it's just the fall. The hamstring seemed to be good. Everything was good until that fall. We're going to be smart here. Everyone saw the fall and how hard it was. Mechanically, we want everything to be right. His back to be feeling right, his hip to be feeling right, but it appears to be everything was good with the comeback on the hamstring.”

Jordan Ott on Devin Booker, Jalen Green, Feb 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: once more on Jalen Green
item.description:
“He just wants be out there. His teammates want him to be out there. We want him to be out there, but there's no pressure from us. We want him back, we want him healthy. We want him with the speed that he has. Everything has to be right. It was great to see him out there just in general, just to see him out there. You could feel his energy. Even after the fall, I felt the impact and felt just an unlucky bounce at this point, but he'll be out there as soon as he can.”

once more on Jalen Green, Feb 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordan Ott on Jalen Green
item.description:
Suns coach Jordan Ott on Feb. 5 trade deadline:

“We have people in place in leadership to take care of a lot of that stuff. We know it's right around the corner, but we love our group. We continue to say that. Our group growing internally. Our big piece we're going to get back is Jalen Green and that's what we're excited about.”

Jordan Ott on Jalen Green, Jan 27, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyler Herro on Terry Rozier, Jalen Green
item.description:
crew chief Mark Davis said in the pool report.

“Herro responds and they are both ejected for fighting fouls. Green is ejected as his actions escalated the altercation. Rozier as well is ejected as his actions were escalators to the altercation. Coach Sullivan is assessed a technical foul and ejected for his unsportsmanlike comments directed at me as I was attempting to redirect [Alperen] Şengün.”

Tyler Herro on Terry Rozier, Jalen Green, Dec 30, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Jalen Green, Alperen Sengun
item.description:
Mitty: Ime Udoka on why Alperen Sengun being out is not the reason for Jalen Green’s resurgence:

“We wanted to really increase the pace and get the threes up and all those things don’t have anything to do with Alpi- When Jalen was struggling earlier in the year he had the same quality looks and Jalen started to read the game better - I think they can complement each other very well”

Ime Udoka on Jalen Green, Alperen Sengun, Mar 28, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Jalen Green
item.description:
Ime Udoka on Jalen Green bouncing back from Toronto:

“He was playing the right way. He got himself in a groove as far as passing early, finding guys... not playing in the crowd as much. I'd like to have a few back, especially a late pass that got batted down there, but he played a solid game all around. Obviously good to see him passing the ball when he has it in his hands more often. There was some good improvement from last game to tonight.”

Ime Udoka on Jalen Green, Feb 10, 2024. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Jalen Green
item.description:
“Obviously, with [Green] playing that way, if he was playing the other way we obviously wouldn’t struggle as much offensively and have to lean on other guys as much or play other guys minutes,”

Ime Udoka on Jalen Green, Dec 28, 2023. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Jalen Green
item.description:
Udoka on Jalen Green:

“He’s a talented scorer but we want him to do everything. We want him to be more well-rounded and that’s going to be the challenge for him.”

Ime Udoka on Jalen Green, Oct 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @KellyIko.

item.title: Grant Hill on Jalen Green
item.description:
“Part of the good and the bad of the select team, I guess, is that we ask them to play a certain way, so he [Jalen Green] maybe didn’t get a chance to play like (he) normally plays,”

Grant Hill on Jalen Green, Aug 9, 2023. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Kevin Porter Jr on Jalen Green
item.description:
Adam Spolane:Kevin Porter Jr on Jalen Green:

“Me and him are like brothers. Blood couldn’t make us any closer, so I'm very comfortable sharing my life and my personal with him, and he's congratulated me,he's happy that we're gonna be together for much longer.”

Kevin Porter Jr on Jalen Green, Oct 17, 2022. Source: Twitter @AdamSpolane.

item.title: Kevin Porter Jr on Jalen Green
item.description:
Adam Spolane:Kevin Porter Jr on Jalen Green:

“He's so talented and he's young. I'm young, but he's young, he a baby, and that's my little brother and it's great to see him succeed because it's hard to succeed in this league. I've been in here, this is my third year...”

Kevin Porter Jr on Jalen Green, Mar 31, 2022. Source: Twitter @AdamSpolane.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Jalen Green
item.description:
Stephen Silas:

“Really good team win. One of the plays of the game for me was that Jalen Green offensive rebound. We've been talking about how he could use his athleticism (to win games)... That was a huge, huge rebound that he got.”

Stephen Silas on Jalen Green, Jan 16, 2022. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Christian Wood on Kevin Porter, Jalen Green
item.description:
Wood told ESPN on Friday.

“We've always stayed together and always had that team chemistry. We know that we're better than a 1-16 record and better than what we were showing. We never put our heads down. We just stayed together. I believe it's real. Especially with Jalen Green being out, which is a key piece, points that [would be] on the board that are not. We're still managing to win games. And with Kevin Porter Jr. out. I think we're even better than we're showing. We're just clicking.”

Christian Wood on Kevin Porter, Jalen Green, Dec 10, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jalen Green
item.description:
Mark Haynes:Steve Kerr on Jalen Green:

“He's just a freak athlete. Incredibly bouncy and fast, dynamic, and he's going to be a great player.”

Steve Kerr on Jalen Green, Nov 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @markhaynesnba.

item.title: Michael Drake on Kevin Porter, Jalen Green, Josh Christopher
item.description:
Alykhan Bijani:Drake on the #Rockets:

“They have some great young talent. Jalen Green, special kid. Josh Christopher. Kevin Porter Jr. They got some special talents. I love that energy that is coming into the league. It’s gonna be fun to watch.”

Michael Drake on Kevin Porter, Jalen Green, Josh Christopher, Oct 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Rafael Stone on Jalen Green
item.description:
Rafael Stone on Jalen Green:

“Jalens's electric. His first step is as good as anybody in basketball. His 2nd and 3rd step is even better. When he jumps, it's really high so good things happen. And on top of that he can handle the ball and shoot. I think Jalen's a bucket.”

Rafael Stone on Jalen Green, Jul 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.
